code:
aws ec2 create-key-pair \
  --key-name my-ec2-keypair \
  --query "KeyMaterial" \
  --output text > my-ec2-keypair.pem

chmod 400 my-ec2-keypair.pem
caption: The private key comes back exactly once — AWS keeps only the public half.
